beats.care: If you're in school, the break is meant for rest after exams. Lowkey, burnt-out students don't learn better.
beats.what: Several Hyderabad schools gave students large holiday homework, and some declared the break from 11 to 21 October instead of 10 to 22.
beats.why: A parent told Siasat the homework is spoiling the holidays, turning the break into home-schooling just after SA1 exams.

cards.body: SA1 exams were held before the break, with results expected after schools reopen. Class 10 pre-finals must finish before 28 February, and SSC board exams are in March 2027. The schools involved were not named.
The state's academic calendar sets the dates. The report says some schools declared fewer days, but it did not say whether officials have acted on this.
cards.title: can a school shorten the holiday?

opts: Homework eats into a rest break after exams
cards.why: The Dasara break comes right after SA1 exams and is meant for rest, not more schoolwork.

hook: 13-day Dasara break… *with a pile of homework*? Parents aren't happy.

learn.t: Telangana's school calendar fixes a 13-day Dasara holiday, 10 to 22 October, with schools reopening on 23 October.

sources.name: The Siasat Daily
sources.title: Hyderabad schools spoil students' Dasara holidays with homework

tldr: Parents say several Hyderabad schools loaded students with homework over the Dasara break, and some cut the official 13-day holiday to 11 days.
watch: Schools reopen on 23 Oct, and SA1 results are expected after the break.
